item.title: Louisiana House OKs bill to name new Mississippi River bridge after Trump
item.description: The Louisiana House passed a bill proposing to name the new Mississippi River Bridge after President Donald Trump Monday afternoon.

item.title: Louisiana lawmakers consider changes to carnival ride safety laws
item.description: Louisiana lawmakers are considering House Bill 937, which would revise the state's amusement ride safety laws to require flat inspection fees, inspections at every new setup location, and exempt inflatables from state-level regulations, while critics worry about the potential financial impact on festivals and attendees.

item.title: Louisiana House votes to crack down on drivers swerving past other cars at red lights
item.description: Have you been stopped at a red light only to have a reckless driver swerve past you on the shoulder and run the light?

item.title: High levels of ‘forever chemicals’ found in Smitty’s Supply stormwater discharges
item.description: Sampling of stormwater discharges from a destroyed petrochemical facility in Tangipahoa Parish detected high levels of cancer-linked compounds known as “forever chemicals,” according to months-old lab reports that state environmental officials released this month.

item.title: Louisiana lawmaker withdraws bill to allow guns on college campuses
item.description: A Louisiana state representative has withdrawn his bill to allow guns on college campuses, killing the proposal for the year.

item.title: Driver flees after leading deputies on chase following failed traffic stop in WBR Parish
item.description: The West Baton Rouge Sheriff's Office is searching for a driver who led deputies on a chase Monday night.

item.title: Louisiana unveils first nuclear energy strategic framework
item.description: Louisiana launches its first Nuclear Strategic Framework, which outlines four top areas of development, the Louisiana Economic Development (LED) announced Tuesday.

item.title: Raising Cane's founder Todd Graves finances artificial reefs in the Gulf
item.description: Coastal Conservation Association Louisiana, in partnership with Raising Cane’s Chicken Fingers, has announced the installation of Eugene Island 74 artificial reef — the second of five reefs made possible through Raising Cane’s owner and founder Todd Graves’ $500,000 commitment to the R.E.E.F. Louisiana program.

item.title: LSU Golf Course set to close permanently. See why
item.description: The LSU Golf Course is set to close permanently this year, the university confirmed Tuesday morning.
